name: HiDiffusion MSW-MSA attention
plain: Multi-scale shifted-window self-attention from HiDiffusion. Tokens are split into 2×2 windows with a shift that changes between blocks, to cut attention cost at high resolution. It reworks the attention batch rather than the model.
math: H,W from tokens. Window = ceil(H/2)×ceil(W/2). Shift index drawn at random from 0..3, giving 0, ¼, ½, ¾ of window size; re-picked to avoid a repeat per last_shift_mode and last_shift_strategy. x rolled by −shift, cut into 4 windows into the batch; attention; reversed and rolled back. Sizes not divisible by 2 use scale_mode, skip or error.
label: from code

audit.note: msw_msa_attention.py:437: the shift is drawn at random, not cycled. :448-460 only re-picks it when it hits an avoided value.
